title: Only 3 Interstellar Visitors Have Ever Been Confirmed
hook: Only 3 confirmed objects arrived from other stars.
closing: Each visitor carries clues about worlds beyond our solar system.
question: Will we ever intercept one?

segments.say: Only 3 interstellar visitors have been confirmed. Each gives scientists a rare sample of another star system.
The newest visitor reached 246,000 kilometers an hour. Its speed reveals how violently it crossed our neighborhood.
Its nucleus measures 5.6 kilometers. A larger target gives telescopes more material to study.
